item.title: Kanye West testifies in trial over Malibu mansion lawsuit
item.description: Ye, the artist formerly known as Kanye West, appeared in a downtown Los Angeles courtroom on Friday to testify in a high-profile civil trial. item.description: A Fullerton family has filed a lawsuit against Union Pacific, claiming the company's failure to maintain an abandoned rail line has led to repeated burglaries and life-threatening fires. item.title: US military: Is there a draft in 2026?
item.description: A measure passed by the House of Representatives in 2024 automatically registers men aged 18 to 26 for selective service.It was part of the annual National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which sets out the U.S. government’s military and national security priorities over the next fiscal year. While it hasn’t been invoked in over half a century, it’s mandatory for all male U.S. citizens to register for the selective service, also known as the military draft, when they turn 18.
